pages.title: Structure Airdrop
pages.text: Right click to deploy: a crate descends from 40 blocks up at 0.15 blocks/tick (about 13 seconds) with clouds trailing behind and a signal flare rising first.$(br2)On landing it becomes a loot chest and the owner is told the coordinates.

pages.title: Beishan Nag Letter
pages.text: Go 5 Minecraft days without using or crafting a Beishan Coin and the nag letter starts following you: slowdown plus pigeon particles above your head, until you spend a coin.
